query: SELECT COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(extra_payload->'payslip'->>'netPayable', extra_payload->>'netPayable') ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN COALESCE(extra_payload->'payslip'->>'netPayable', extra_payload->>'netPayable')::numeric END, amount)),0)::numeric AS "amount!" FROM ledger_entries WHERE household_id=$1 AND direction='income' AND status='actual' AND owner_scope=ANY($2) AND entry_date >= $3 AND entry_date < $4
